milestones.name: Product Definition & MVP Planning
milestones.description: Agree what the marketplace is: new & used phones, verified stores, MVP scope.

milestones.name: User Journeys & Screen Mapping
milestones.description: Map every customer, merchant and admin journey to concrete screens.
milestones.completion: Every user goal is covered by at least one screen; IDs agreed.

milestones.name: Technology Architecture
milestones.description: Flutter app, React portal, Django REST API, PostgreSQL, R2 storage, Redis/Celery.
milestones.completion: Architecture reviewed and approved by both founders.

milestones.name: Database & API Design
milestones.description: Domain model: users, stores, verifications, catalog, listings, inventory, audit.

milestones.name: Authentication & Permissions

milestones.name: Store Verification & Administration
milestones.description: Verification applications, evidence review, approve/reject/request-changes, audit events.
milestones.completion: A test store passes the full verification lifecycle with audit trail.

milestones.name: Product Catalog & Inventory
milestones.description: Catalog products/variants, new-stock quantity listings, individual used-device listings.
milestones.deliverable: Catalog, listing, inventory & media models + APIs
milestones.completion: New and used listing flows both persist correctly with media.

milestones.name: Mobile Application Development
milestones.description: Flutter customer app: browse, search, details, stores, compare, contact, account.
milestones.deliverable: Flutter app wired to real APIs (AR/EN, RTL)
milestones.completion: All C-series MVP screens work against the staging API.

milestones.name: Merchant Dashboard Development
milestones.description: React portal: registration, business info, verification, listings, inventory, settings.
milestones.deliverable: Merchant portal wired to real APIs (AR/EN, RTL)
milestones.completion: A merchant can register, get verified, and publish a listing end-to-end.

milestones.name: Marketplace Integration
milestones.description: Public listing visibility, search across stores, moderation queue, admin operations.
milestones.completion: Published listings appear in customer search within SLA; moderation works.

milestones.name: Testing & Stabilization
milestones.description: Integration tests, security checks, both interfaces regression-tested, bug fixing.
milestones.completion: No open critical bugs; security checklist fully green.

milestones.name: Production Deployment
milestones.description: Deploy API, portals and storage; configure monitoring, backups, alerts.
milestones.completion: Deployment runbook executed; monitoring dashboards live.

milestones.name: Pilot Launch
milestones.description: Onboard first verified phone stores, support them closely, collect feedback.
milestones.deliverable: Pilot cohort of verified stores trading
milestones.completion: Pilot stores successfully publish listings and receive customer contact.

milestones.name: Monitoring & Future Expansion
milestones.description: Track metrics, stabilize, then: saved listings, advertising, announcements, AI features.
milestones.completion: Expansion features scheduled; pilot lessons folded into backlog.

backlog.title: [P2][BE] BE-01: Django/DRF foundation and real API contract tooling
backlog.depends: SCOPE-01 + GATE-01
backlog.details: Initialize the selected Django/DRF/PostgreSQL foundation with pinned dependencies and actual checks. Adapt make openapi/openapi-check and shared adapters in a reviewed stack-transition PR before implementation tasks are released. Do not create a placeholder API.
backlog.acceptance: Django checks and actual registered schema export work without production secrets; migrations and PostgreSQL tests run; clean CI reports real prerequisites; operating contracts and task skills agree with the selected stack.

backlog.title: [P2][BE] BE-02: Configuration, localization and shared API conventions
backlog.depends: BE-01 + GATE-01
backlog.details: Implement public config/localization, consistent errors, locale/currency flags and contract conventions. Agree pagination/filter semantics, canonical paths/trailing slashes, request IDs and examples with Moataz.
backlog.acceptance: Config and localization are public and contain no personal data; clients can map documented errors/offline states; shared contract examples are agreed and tested.

backlog.title: [P3][BE] BE-03: Identity, sessions and scoped authorization
backlog.depends: GATE-02
backlog.details: Merchant authentication, sessions, password recovery and object permissions. Customer accounts C-07 remain a scope decision; do not gate public browsing on login.
backlog.acceptance: Cross-store access is rejected; recovery/session cases and rate limits have tests; agreed auth contracts work with the frontend; optional customer accounts implemented only if scope is accepted.

backlog.title: [P3][BE] BE-04: Store profile, membership and merchant settings
backlog.depends: GATE-02 + BE-03
backlog.details: Implement business profile, store membership/staff and merchant-safe responses. Settings contracts support later M-11 work; live inventory/dashboard metrics are delivered with BE-10/P6 after listings exist.
backlog.acceptance: Ownership and membership rules are enforced at every mutation; invalid profiles rejected; public/private fields separated; role changes tested and auditable.

backlog.title: [P3][BE] BE-05: Verification evidence, founder review and decisions
backlog.depends: GATE-02 + BE-03 + BE-04
backlog.details: Implement merchant submission/status plus founder queue, protected evidence access, decisions/reasons and audit events. Bring A-02/A-03/A-04 forward into P3 so store approval can be tested now.
backlog.acceptance: Unverified/suspended stores cannot publish; private evidence is never public; review/document access and reasons are audited; approve/reject/request-changes are tested; P3 reversals remain rejected until BE-10/A-07 dual approval is implemented and integrated in P6.

backlog.title: [P4][BE] BE-06: Product catalog, models, brands and variants
backlog.depends: GATE-03
backlog.details: Catalog/variant API consumed by listing forms and public brand/category browsing. Agree stable IDs and validation with Moataz.
backlog.acceptance: Brand/model/variant selectors compose; unsupported variants fail predictably; fixtures cover new/used forms and comparable offers.

backlog.title: [P4][BE] BE-07: New/used listings, publication, stock and price
backlog.depends: GATE-03 + BE-06
backlog.details: Separate quantity-based new stock from individual used devices; implement drafts/publication status and safe price/stock updates. Coordinate optimistic concurrency and retry behavior with the clients. Include the minimum audited founder moderation queue/action API and A-05 handoff in P4, before real pending-to-published acceptance.
backlog.acceptance: Only approved eligible stores publish; new and used invariants hold; stale updates conflict safely; private identifiers never leak; required media readiness gates publication; the agreed publication trigger moves eligible/media-ready inventory from pending to published through the real API/job path; founders must decide automatic versus manual publication in SCOPE-01. Never use direct DB edits as acceptance evidence.

backlog.title: [P4][BE] BE-08: Authorized media upload and processing
backlog.depends: GATE-03 + BE-03 + BE-04
backlog.details: Authorized public listing media flow and processing/retry callbacks. Keep business-verification evidence on a separate private access path. Confirm storage/job services before adding dependencies.
backlog.acceptance: Unauthorized uploads fail; files are validated and safely processed; retries are idempotent; drafts cannot become public before media readiness; private evidence is inaccessible publicly.

backlog.title: [P5][BE] BE-09: Public discovery, store profiles and seller contact
backlog.depends: GATE-04 + BE-02 + BE-06 + BE-07
backlog.details: Implement home, search/filter/pagination, listing/store details, compare and contact methods. Guests may browse. Promotions remain a scope decision, separate from core discovery.
backlog.acceptance: Eligibility hides unapproved/suspended inventory; filters compose and paginate stably; contact methods match policy; freshness/unavailable cases are explicit; public responses exclude private evidence/device data.

backlog.title: [P6][BE] BE-10: Merchant/founder operations, roles and audit
backlog.depends: GATE-05 + BE-03 + BE-05
backlog.details: Complete live merchant dashboard inventory metrics, founder overview, role administration and audit/dual-approval interfaces, and harden the minimum moderation workflow already delivered in P4. Keep founder routes separate from merchant authorization.
backlog.acceptance: Critical actions are auditable; requester cannot self-approve; all founder/merchant negative authorization tests pass; moderation state changes affect public visibility correctly.

backlog.title: [Later][BE] BE-11: Saved listings, advertising and announcements after MVP
backlog.depends: Accepted later-scope decision
backlog.details: Later-only saved listings, campaigns/results/review/announcements. Home promotion placement is an explicit scope question, not assumed MVP work.
backlog.acceptance: Later scope, moderation/delivery rules and business owner are accepted before implementation; contracts and real integration tests then pass.

backlog.title: [P8][BE] BE-12: Deployment, monitoring and backup/restore readiness
backlog.depends: GATE-07
backlog.details: Prepare reviewed production/staging runbooks, monitoring/alerts, storage/worker operations and tested backups. Deploy only with separate explicit authorization.
backlog.acceptance: Restore drill succeeds; operational runbooks and monitoring evidence are reviewed; pilot go/no-go is jointly recorded; this task does not itself authorize deployment.

backlog.title: [P2][FE] FE-00: Flutter customer and React merchant/admin foundations
backlog.depends: SCOPE-01 + GATE-01
backlog.details: Initialize Flutter and React shells with routing, environment handling, AR/EN + RTL, shared loading/error/offline states and agreed API fixtures. No Kotlin-only skills or implementation.
backlog.acceptance: Flutter and React build/test checks pass; guest/merchant/founder shells render; agreed fixtures work; no claims of live API integration until the matching integration gate.

backlog.title: [P2][FE] C-00: Application Entry

Splash/loading state, localization initialization, guest access and app configuration.
Screen: C-00; source priority: MVP.
Frontend work: Render splash with animated logo; Request config, apply locale and theme (AR/EN, RTL/LTR); Cache last good config for offline starts; Route to C-01 or C-07 based on session
Backend handoff: Serve lightweight config endpoint (feature flags, versions); Serve localization bundles; No personal data returned without auth
Source navigation/data dependencies (not automatic build edges): Precedes every customer screen; feeds locale to the whole app.
Screen inputs (request schema still needs contract review): 
Validation: None — passive screen
Access: Public — no authentication required.
UI states: Loading; Config failed → retry screen; Offline → continue with cached config
backlog.acceptance:
- App opens to splash in under 2s on mid-range devices
- Guest access lands on C-01 homepage
- Locale (AR/EN + RTL) applied before first content screen
Merged frontend implementation must state fixture/live-API limits. Phase completion additionally requires its joint integration gate.
